notes: The FY2025 10-K gives only the share of full-time employees outside the U.S. (28% of 4,429 at Dec 31, 2025); the U.S. share was not derived. No state, country, investment or tax breakdown is published. The cover page now gives the principal executive offices as Aventura, Florida (former address Denver, Colorado), and Item 2 says Denver 'was the location of our corporate headquarters'; Denver is kept as a leased principal property. Item 2 lists five leased principal properties and 'various other office spaces throughout the world'.
